name: National Food Security Act (Ration)
summary: Subsidized food grains (rice ₹3/kg, wheat ₹2/kg) through ration shops
hindi_summary: Ration ki dukaan se sasta anaj — chawal 3 rupaye kilo, gehu 2 rupaye kilo
benefits: Rice at ₹3/kg, wheat at ₹2/kg, coarse grains at ₹1/kg, 5kg per person per month
eligibility: BPL families, Antyodaya card holders, priority households
